description: Startup job listings from Wellfound (formerly AngelList Talent) for a role, either remote or in a city: job title, job type, compensation range as posted (salary, sometimes equity), locations, remote flag and accepted remote regions, years of experience, posted date and job URL, grouped with the hiring startup (name, one-line pitch, company size, badges such as stage or actively hiring, profile URL). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: City slug when remote=false, e.g. new-york, san-francisco, london

remote.description: true (default) for remote jobs; false to use location

role.description: Role slug as in Wellfound URLs, e.g. software-engineer, data-scientist, product-manager, designer (required)

name: jobs_wellfound_jobs
title: Jobs Wellfound Jobs
